segments.summary: Reviewed all 315 core lines and all eight assigned source-unit refs under exact and adversarial lenses. The window provides clear shared-state ownership, bridge retirement, opt-in checkpoint, exceptional-decision, PAUSE precedence, HITLRequest vocabulary, qualified destructive commands, timeout defaults, and non-buildability constraints. Material gaps remain in behavioral oracles, typed request and exception lifecycles, checkpoint and timeout transitions, PAUSE race-safe validation, destructive-command authority and idempotency, GUI classification, privacy, accessibility, localization, offline behavior, scale, and support observability.
